tolerance.notes: D-10 default abs <= 1e-9 + 1e-9*|ref|; per-feature overrides live in features[].tolerance with a reason

notes: Hand-maintained 117-row tsfresh/numpy parity contract (D-01/D-02, Phase 14). Each row names the exact tsfresh.feature_extraction.feature_calculators function + params (reference: 'tsfresh'), or a hand-written numpy/scipy formula (reference: 'numpy/scipy') for names with no tsfresh counterpart. validation/reference/python/gen_tsfresh_features.py reads this file and calls the named calculator DIRECTLY (never tsfresh.extract_features()'s settings-driven convenience API, which silently uses the wrong parameter grid for several of this project's exact choices -- see 14-RESEARCH.md Pitfall 2). status is 'match' once the Rust extract_features() output matches the computed reference value on every fixture series, or 'pending:<owner-plan>' while a later Phase 14 plan (14-02/14-03/14-04) still owns the fix. crates/anofox-fcst-core/tests/tsfresh_features_reference.rs enforces that every pending row still mismatches somewhere (the ratchet) and that every match row matches everywhere, honouring any documented 'deviation' entries. This plan (14-01) adds only the five partial_autocorrelation_lag{1..5} rows (FEAT-01); the remaining 112 names are added by plan 14-02 task 1.

features.name: length
features.definition: Number of observations (tsfresh length).

features.name: sum
features.definition: Sum of all values (tsfresh sum_values).

features.name: mean
features.definition: Arithmetic mean (tsfresh mean).

features.name: minimum
features.definition: Minimum value (tsfresh minimum).

features.name: maximum
features.definition: Maximum value (tsfresh maximum).

features.name: range
features.definition: Range (max - min); no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: variance
features.definition: Population variance, ddof=0 (tsfresh variance).

features.name: standard_deviation
features.definition: Population standard deviation, ddof=0 (tsfresh standard_deviation).

features.name: variation_coefficient
features.definition: std(x) / mean(x), signed (tsfresh variation_coefficient).

features.name: large_standard_deviation
features.definition: 1.0 if std(x) > r * (max-min) else 0.0, r=0.25 (tsfresh large_standard_deviation).

features.name: median
features.definition: Median value (tsfresh median).

features.name: quantile_0.1
features.definition: Quantile q=0.1 (tsfresh quantile).

features.name: quantile_0.25
features.definition: Quantile q=0.25 (tsfresh quantile).

features.name: quantile_0.75
features.definition: Quantile q=0.75 (tsfresh quantile).

features.name: quantile_0.9
features.definition: Quantile q=0.9 (tsfresh quantile).

features.name: skewness
features.definition: pandas Series.skew (bias-corrected G1), shared with ts_stats (D-05).

deviation.reason: zero-variance sample: G1/G2 are 0/0; scipy skew/kurtosis(bias=False) and ts_stats return NaN (D-05); pandas/tsfresh return 0 by convention, which is arguably wrong for an undefined moment (D-03).

features.name: kurtosis
features.definition: pandas Series.kurtosis (bias-corrected excess G2), shared with ts_stats (D-05).

deviation.reason: zero-variance sample: G1/G2 are 0/0; scipy skew/kurtosis(bias=False) and ts_stats return NaN (D-05); pandas/tsfresh return 0 by convention, which is arguably wrong for an undefined moment (D-03).

features.name: count_above_mean
features.definition: Count of values strictly above the mean (tsfresh count_above_mean).

features.name: count_below_mean
features.definition: Count of values strictly below the mean (tsfresh count_below_mean).

features.name: percentage_above_mean
features.definition: Fraction of values strictly above the mean; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: zero_crossing_rate
features.formula: count of i in 0..n-2 with x[i]!=0, x[i+1]!=0 and sign(x[i])!=sign(x[i+1]), divided by max(n-1,1)
features.definition: Zero-crossing rate; tsfresh's closest calculator (number_crossing_m) has no rate/exact-zero-exclusion semantics, so this stays a documented numpy reference (D-02, Open Question 1).

features.name: mean_change
features.definition: Mean of first differences (tsfresh mean_change).

features.name: mean_abs_change
features.definition: Mean of |first differences| (tsfresh mean_abs_change).

features.name: first_value
features.definition: First value; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: last_value
features.definition: Last value; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: first_location_of_maximum
features.definition: argmax(x)/n, 0-based (tsfresh first_location_of_maximum).

features.name: last_location_of_maximum
features.definition: 1 - argmax(x[::-1])/n == (last_idx+1)/n, 0-based last_idx (tsfresh last_location_of_maximum).

features.name: first_location_of_minimum
features.definition: argmin(x)/n, 0-based (tsfresh first_location_of_minimum).

features.name: last_location_of_minimum
features.definition: 1 - argmin(x[::-1])/n == (last_idx+1)/n, 0-based last_idx (tsfresh last_location_of_minimum).

features.name: abs_energy
features.definition: Sum of squared values (tsfresh abs_energy).

features.name: root_mean_square
features.definition: sqrt(mean(x^2)) (tsfresh root_mean_square).

features.name: mean_second_derivative_central
features.definition: (x[-1]-x[-2]-x[1]+x[0]) / (2*(n-2)) (tsfresh mean_second_derivative_central).

features.name: cid_ce
features.definition: Complexity-invariant distance of the (unnormalized) series to itself (tsfresh cid_ce, normalize=false).

features.name: absolute_sum_of_changes
features.definition: Sum of |first differences| (tsfresh absolute_sum_of_changes).

features.name: lempel_ziv_complexity
features.definition: tsfresh's min/max-quantized sub-word-growth algorithm, bins=2; current Rust is mean-thresholded with a different dictionary-growth loop and log2(n)/n normalization (full algorithm rewrite, D-08).

features.name: longest_strike_above_mean
features.definition: Longest run of consecutive values above the mean (tsfresh longest_strike_above_mean).

features.name: longest_strike_below_mean
features.definition: Longest run of consecutive values below the mean (tsfresh longest_strike_below_mean).

features.name: number_peaks
features.definition: Count of points exceeding all neighbours within +/-n (n=1 support; tsfresh number_peaks).

features.name: number_peaks_threshold_1
features.formula: count of interior i with x[i]>x[i-1], x[i]>x[i+1] and |x[i]-mean(x)| > 1*std(x)
features.definition: Sigma-scaled amplitude-thresholded peak count, k=1; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: number_peaks_threshold_2
features.formula: count of interior i with x[i]>x[i-1], x[i]>x[i+1] and |x[i]-mean(x)| > 2*std(x)
features.definition: Sigma-scaled amplitude-thresholded peak count, k=2; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: benford_correlation
features.definition: Correlation of the first-significant-digit distribution to Benford's law over ALL nonzero finite values (incl. |v|<1); current Rust excludes |v|<1 and divides by the wrong denominator.

features.name: linear_trend_slope
features.definition: OLS slope of x against index (tsfresh linear_trend, attr=slope).

features.name: linear_trend_intercept
features.definition: OLS intercept of x against index (tsfresh linear_trend, attr=intercept).

features.name: linear_trend_r_squared
features.definition: scipy.stats.linregress(np.arange(n), x).rvalue ** 2; NaN for a constant series (scipy degenerate rvalue is NaN).

features.name: binned_entropy
features.definition: Shannon entropy over np.histogram(x, bins=10)'s floor-based bins; current Rust uses a rounding-based binning scheme with different boundaries.

features.name: sample_entropy
features.definition: tsfresh sample_entropy: m=2, r=0.2*population std(x), Chebyshev distance, full symmetric match-count matrix minus self-matches (B/A), -ln(A/B) on the raw sums -- shares the stats.rs template_match_counts band search with ts_stats' approximate_entropy.

features.name: approximate_entropy
features.definition: Pincus approximate entropy, m=2, r=0.2 (tsfresh approximate_entropy). Current Rust returns NaN (vs tsfresh 0.0) on constant/all-zero input, and the wrong sign on tiny_n8 -- both beyond the audit's original edge-case-only finding (the executor's real run is authoritative, 14-RESEARCH.md).

features.name: permutation_entropy
features.definition: -sum(p*ln(p)) over rank-encoded windows (dimension=3, tau=1), NOT normalized by ln(dimension!); current Rust normalizes by ln(order!).

features.name: count_unique
features.definition: Count of distinct values; no tsfresh counterpart (D-02).

features.name: ratio_value_number_to_length
features.definition: len(unique(x)) / n (tsfresh ratio_value_number_to_time_series_length).

features.name: has_duplicate
features.definition: 1.0 if any value repeats else 0.0 (tsfresh has_duplicate).

features.name: has_duplicate_max
features.definition: 1.0 if the maximum value occurs more than once else 0.0 (tsfresh has_duplicate_max).

features.name: has_duplicate_min
features.definition: 1.0 if the minimum value occurs more than once else 0.0 (tsfresh has_duplicate_min).

features.name: percentage_of_reoccurring_datapoints_to_all_datapoints
features.definition: Fraction of datapoints that belong to a value occurring more than once, counted with multiplicity (tsfresh).

features.name: percentage_of_reoccurring_values_to_all_values
features.definition: Fraction of distinct values that occur more than once (tsfresh).

features.name: sum_of_reoccurring_values
features.definition: Sum of distinct values that occur more than once, each counted once (tsfresh sum_of_reoccurring_values).

features.name: sum_of_reoccurring_datapoints
features.definition: Sum of values that occur more than once, counted with multiplicity (tsfresh sum_of_reoccurring_data_points).

features.name: spectral_centroid
features.definition: First raw moment of the one-sided |rfft(x)| spectrum (tsfresh fft_aggregated, aggtype=centroid), computed via rustfft's O(n log n) forward FFT.

features.name: spectral_variance
features.definition: Second central moment of the one-sided |rfft(x)| spectrum (tsfresh fft_aggregated, aggtype=variance), computed via rustfft's O(n log n) forward FFT.

features.name: agg_linear_trend_slope
features.definition: OLS slope of the mean-aggregated-chunk fit, chunk_len=max(n//10,2), f_agg=mean (tsfresh agg_linear_trend).

features.name: agg_linear_trend_intercept
features.definition: OLS intercept of the mean-aggregated-chunk fit, chunk_len=max(n//10,2), f_agg=mean (tsfresh agg_linear_trend).

features.name: agg_linear_trend_rvalue
features.definition: Signed Pearson r of the OLS fit over mean-aggregated chunks of length max(n//10,2) (tsfresh agg_linear_trend, f_agg=mean).

features.name: agg_linear_trend_stderr
features.definition: OLS stderr of the mean-aggregated-chunk fit, chunk_len=max(n//10,2), f_agg=mean (tsfresh agg_linear_trend). NaN on a degenerate (zero-variance) chunk-mean series or when there are exactly 2 chunks (df=0).

features.definition: Partial autocorrelation at lag 1, Durbin-Levinson recursion on the adjusted (n-k denominator) autocovariance (statsmodels pacf(method='ld')).

features.name: partial_autocorrelation_lag2
features.definition: Partial autocorrelation at lag 2, Durbin-Levinson recursion on the adjusted (n-k denominator) autocovariance (statsmodels pacf(method='ld')).

features.name: partial_autocorrelation_lag3
features.definition: Partial autocorrelation at lag 3, Durbin-Levinson recursion on the adjusted (n-k denominator) autocovariance (statsmodels pacf(method='ld')).

features.name: ratio_beyond_r_sigma_1
features.definition: Fraction of values more than 1 standard deviations from the mean (tsfresh ratio_beyond_r_sigma, r=1).

features.name: ratio_beyond_r_sigma_2
features.definition: Fraction of values more than 2 standard deviations from the mean (tsfresh ratio_beyond_r_sigma, r=2).

features.name: ratio_beyond_r_sigma_3
features.definition: Fraction of values more than 3 standard deviations from the mean (tsfresh ratio_beyond_r_sigma, r=3).

features.name: time_reversal_asymmetry_stat_1
features.definition: mean(x[i+2lag]^2*x[i+lag] - x[i+lag]*x[i]^2), lag=1 (tsfresh time_reversal_asymmetry_statistic).

features.name: time_reversal_asymmetry_stat_2
features.definition: mean(x[i+2lag]^2*x[i+lag] - x[i+lag]*x[i]^2), lag=2 (tsfresh time_reversal_asymmetry_statistic).

features.name: time_reversal_asymmetry_stat_3
features.definition: mean(x[i+2lag]^2*x[i+lag] - x[i+lag]*x[i]^2), lag=3 (tsfresh time_reversal_asymmetry_statistic).

features.name: c3_lag1
features.definition: mean(x_lead2*x_lead*x), lag=1 (tsfresh c3).

features.name: c3_lag2
features.definition: mean(x_lead2*x_lead*x), lag=2 (tsfresh c3).

features.name: c3_lag3
features.definition: mean(x_lead2*x_lead*x), lag=3 (tsfresh c3).
